what: Timing of the live web prototype (https://drfaizb-thermal-paddy-classifier.static.hf.space) in the Chromium-based browser pane of the Claude desktop app on Dr Faiz's Mac
files_checked: Live model.json and shards 1 and 12 byte-identical (SHA-256) to 02_Web_App_HuggingFace/; live index.html identical apart from one line injected by Hugging Face

environment.gpu_reported_by_browser: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3)
environment.tfjs_backend: webgl (library default; the page does not set a backend)

per_image_time_ms.definition: same region the app times: preprocess (resize, crop, resize) + model.predict + read-back of the six probabilities (dataSync); image decoding excluded; model already warmed up as in the app
per_image_time_ms.input: 320 x 240 canvas image (random pixels); content-independence checked with blank, gradient and random inputs (medians 36.3, 36.5, 36.8 ms over 30 runs each)

model_download.definition: model.json + 12 weight files fetched with cache disabled (cache:'no-store'), all in parallel

page_ready_ms.definition: time from inserting the page in a fresh iframe (new JavaScript and WebGL context) until the status reads 'Model ready' (includes loading TensorFlow.js and the model, and the app's warm-up prediction); browser cache not cleared, so these are repeat visits
